config.population: the posebuster set; 1275 rows of the other set excluded, a second population rather than a second cell
config.excluded_rows: crystal_structures: the re-scored reference, not a method, and it has no minimised arm

criteria.rmsd2: distance alone at the field's default tolerance
criteria.rmsd2+valid: distance and every recorded validity check
criteria.rmsd1: distance alone at half the tolerance
criteria.rmsd2+chem: distance and the intramolecular checks only

declared_conventions: the flatness checks ('aromatic_ring_flatness_passes', 'double_bond_flatness_passes') are recorded only under post-processing 'none', so they are dropped from every cell rather than from one
a row with no scorable pose counts as a miss, not as an absent observation

flatness_checks_included_instead.note: the two checks exist only in the un-minimised arm; including them changes the published cell by this much, which is why dropping them from every cell is the convention that keeps a criterion the same object across the grid
